messages:
maya: customer PIN-823 reporting mass 429s and slow responses during their 20:07 UTC hourly batch. They say autoscaler didn’t add capacity until ~20:23.

anna-oncall: copying. can you add the probe logs + any kube events?

maya: paste logs excerpt:
```
2026-02-14T20:07:12Z attach: probe heartbeat missed (warmpool-probe id=wp-47)
2026-02-14T20:08:05Z pod PIN-823-01 Pending -> ContainerCreating (imagePullBackOff)
2026-02-14T20:09:18Z attach: auth 401 on service-account refresh
2026-02-14T20:15:40Z autoscaler: target_replicas=3 current_replicas=3 pending_attach=7
```

luis-dev: interesting — imagePullBackOff + auth 401s. imagePull shouldn't block autoscaler from scheduling, but pending_attach count stays high. could be attach probe suppression if probes keep failing.

jamie-sre: i also see kube events: several pods stuck ContainerCreating between 20:08-20:14; attach controller retried but hit auth failures at 20:09. autoscaler logs show repeated probe suppression events at 20:10 (priority deprioritization triggered).

eric-cs: customer confirms they rotated a key earlier but said it was a read-only rotation, no billing flags. i pulled auth logs: multiple token refresh 401s at 20:08-20:10 from their SA.

maya: repro steps i've been doing locally to mimic the spike:
```bash
# generate 120 concurrent requests to the pinned route
for i in {1..120}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/pin/823/generate -d '{"input":"x"}' & done; wait
```
results: attach queue climbs quickly, several requests 429 until warmchain finishes.

anna-oncall: short mitigation: bump tenant min_replicas to 4 and flip warmpool probe bypass for this tenant to reduce suppression. i'll push a temporary override.

deploy-bot: prod-config updated: tenant PIN-823 override -> min_replicas=4 at 2026-02-14T20:29:12Z by anna-oncall.

luis-dev: long term we should add jitter to attach retries and reduce tight retry loops that amplify noisy-tenant effects. also consider a small reserved headroom for high-burst tenants.

jamie-sre: quick root-cause hypothesis: combined auth-token refresh failures + imagePull backoffs created an attach backlog. autoscaler saw probe failures and deprioritized scaling (probe suppression), so it didn't create enough headroom quickly. noisy tenant traffic then kept existing capacity saturated -> user 429s.

eric-cs: customer verified performance improved after min_replicas bump — p95 latency dropped ~60% within 6 minutes. they're OK with the temporary change.

maya: next actions: 1) file incident doc + timeline 2) follow up with infra to add attach-retry jitter 3) add tenant burst quota proposal 4) improve probe telemetry to expose suppression triggers. i'll own the incident doc.

anna-oncall: noted. i'll also schedule a small rollback window to revert min_replicas override after we validate infra changes.

maya: thanks all — closing thread, will post incident link once doc is up.
